paper_title: Search for Axion Dark Matter from 1.1 to 1.3 GHz with ADMX
notes: ADMX searched for axion dark matter in the 1.10–1.31 GHz frequency range (4.54–5.41 µeV mass range). The paper reports achieving better-than-KSVZ sensitivity across the explored frequency range at 90% confidence level. The limit is mass-independent (flat) across the scanned range, so encoded as a two-point horizontal line. The coupling g_agamma is related to the model-dependent constant g_γ by g_agamma = α*g_γ/(π*f_a); the paper reports KSVZ sensitivity (g_γ = −0.97) but does not explicitly tabulate g_agamma values. The approximate limit of ~2.7×10^−16 GeV^−1 is inferred from Fig. 3 (the exclusion plot showing the purple ADMX limit at KSVZ level). Local dark matter density assumed: 0.45 GeV/cm³ (Maxwell-Boltzmann halo model). No axion signal was detected; all candidates were vetted and eliminated.
